name: @sauce/names
description: The classes a chain's tokens are instances of: an ERC-20 token, and the running contract's balance of one. The SDK writes one module per chain from its registry whose tokens are instances of these, and hands it to every program compiled for that chain as an ambient module. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (names.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because a Solana token is a mint's key, with no token methods.
